item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find direct 2024 evidence of backchannel crisis management, hotline use, military-to-military deconfliction, or a specific acute war scare where Sharif personally stepped in to cool tensions. I also did not find credible evidence that he worsened an acute crisis through unclear signaling.
